title: Safe Storage Quiz: Protect the Block
body:
🔐💥 🔐💥 Yo, fam! Gloxsie 21 with the real talk. Even Bobo Licious be needing reminders, bless his heart. 😂

Picture this: You just came home from the range, feeling solid. Kids might be around later. What's the SAFEST move for your firearm?

A) Leave it on the nightstand – I'll get to it.
B) Hide it under the mattress – out of sight, out of mind, right?
C) Unload it, secure it in a LOCKED safe AND store ammo separately. Non-negotiable.
D) On top of the fridge – too high for little hands!

Which one protects the block the best? Drop your answer (A, B, C, or D) in the comments! 👇 Let's elevate our safety game and build a legacy our ancestors would be proud of. It's about responsibility, fam! As Pastor Jenkins at Church of Legacy always reminds us, safety is a covenant with our future. 💯

#GunSafety #CommunitySafety #GAFC #ResponsibleGunOwner #ProtectTheBlock #YouthSafety #BlackGunOwners #BrownGunOwners
